explanation: Seven overview HTTP 503 responses correlate within milliseconds with PostgreSQL parallel-worker dynamic shared-memory allocation failures. Container /dev/shm was 64 MiB despite a 4 GiB memory quota. The optimized inlined usage join can use parallel hash join (shared hash state); concurrent workers can exhaust /dev/shm. These are resource errors, not the handler 5-second context deadline. adminServiceError maps otherwise unclassified query errors to admin_unavailable HTTP 503 without SQL logging.
limit: Read-only plan comparison had one query at a time and did not exercise concurrent shared-memory demand. Increasing shm-size changes environment; successful retry must not erase this failure or claim unchanged topology.
